data_version.en-US: Several annual and quarterly receipts; do not merge unequal horizons or panels.
data_version.zh-CN: 多个年频与季频回执，不能合并不同期限或面板。

missing.en-US: A source entry or artifact hash does not certify a complete rerun; original availability, dependencies and historical eligibility must match.
missing.zh-CN: 来源入口或产物哈希不等于完整复跑认证；原始可得性、依赖和历史资格必须一致。

resume_when.en-US: Demonstrate stable same-fold improvement over persistence and current fundamentals on separately qualified stock-return labels.
resume_when.zh-CN: 在同折、独立核实的股票收益标签上证明超过 persistence 与当前基本面的稳定增量。

action.en-US: Recompute corrected forecasts and audit archived return paths.
action.zh-CN: 重新核算修正后的预测，检查历史收益路径。

acceptance.en-US: All 12 full-precision summaries reconcile; paired formation intervals and corrected initial-capital boundary drawdown are retained.
acceptance.zh-CN: 12 组完整精度汇总核对一致，保留按测试期配对的区间和补入初始资金的期末回撤。

action.en-US: Compare numeric levels and changes with no-change and seasonal controls.
action.zh-CN: 把水平预测和变化预测与零变化、去年同期对照比较。

acceptance.en-US: Four matched historical groups complete; accounting extremes, numerical warnings, undefined ranks and negative-change prevalence stay visible.
acceptance.zh-CN: 四组同样本历史实验完成，会计极值、数值警告和无法计算的排序相关保留，实际下降比例可查。

action.en-US: Register robust accounting transforms and material deterioration thresholds before a new experiment.
action.zh-CN: 下一轮先登记会计极值处理方法和有经营意义的恶化幅度。

acceptance.en-US: Compare on matched dates and rows with no-change and seasonal controls; report prevalence, paired intervals and block-length sensitivity without selecting on test outcomes.
acceptance.zh-CN: 固定日期和记录，与零变化和同期对照比较，报告实际下降比例及配对区间，不按测试结果挑规则。

action.en-US: Qualify historical eligibility, vintages, terminal events and execution before matched current-state, valuation and forecast return arms.
action.zh-CN: 先核实历史资格、财报版本和退市处理，明确成交规则，再比较当前基本面、估值和预测的收益。

acceptance.en-US: Retain dated input qualification and identical candidates, dates and costs in all arms; preserve the current decision if unresolved.
acceptance.zh-CN: 保留有日期的数据核查记录，各组日期、股票和成本相同。缺口未解决则保留当前判断。
